name: Aud
title: Aud | Amplifier Smart Tools
description: Clean up speech, shape the sound, and reach the loudness you want. Aud turns a finished recording into an inspectable mastering plan, then applies the chain in one render.
caption: Mastering-chain animation from the Aud repository.
flow_title: Hear the difference. Keep the plan.
flow_intro: Clean up speech, shape the sound, and reach the loudness you want. Aud turns a finished recording into an inspectable mastering plan, then applies the chain in one render.
steps: Understand loudness, peaks, tonal balance, and the dynamics already in the file.
Trim pauses, tame harshness, balance frequencies, and set a loudness target.
Apply the plan in one pass, then measure the result against the targets.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: Find silences and filler words, then make edits with padded boundaries and crossfades.
Use EQ, multiband compression, and reference matching to shape the sound.
Save a mastering plan, start from a preset, and reuse the same chain across recordings.
prompt: Use Aud to finish my recording. Read aud --help and the relevant command help. Measure the file, propose a mastering plan, and show me the plan before rendering. Verify the result against the agreed targets.
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and uv. The setup guide covers FFmpeg for compressed formats and optional speech and time-stretch features.
model_note: Model-backed advice and automatic mastering use your configured AI provider. Measurement, explicit mastering chains, rendering, and verification run locally.
